# traffic.dliu.com health checks

<!-- Generated by scripts/health-docs.js from config/health.json; the same content as https://traffic.dliu.com/docs/health. -->

Every 15 minutes status.dliu.com checks this site as a guest (not signed in, no cookies): it opens the public pages and URLs, then reads /health, which reports whether each behind-the-scenes function is working.

- Human version: https://traffic.dliu.com/docs/health
- Contract: every dliu.com site follows the health contract of status.dliu.com (https://status.dliu.com/docs).

## Functions

The site is **down** when a critical function fails, and **degraded** when any other function fails.

| Key | Name | Critical | What is checked | If it is down |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | Pages | yes | The dashboard and the docs pages open. | Visitors cannot open traffic.dliu.com. |
| `public-stats` | Public statistics | no | The 7, 30 and 90-day totals guests see are refreshed every day. | Guests see numbers stuck on an old day. |
| `page-script` | Page script | no | The page script the sites load, /t/s.js, downloads. | The sites stop reporting time on page and clicks. |
| `signin` | Microsoft sign-in | no | Sign in sends you to Microsoft, and private data stays locked without it. | The owner cannot sign in to see the full dashboard; guests are not affected. |
| `logging` | Request logging | yes | The log files CloudFront delivers for every site are filed as they arrive. | New visits are no longer recorded, and the dashboard stops moving. |
| `bot-check` | Bot check | no | The bot check that runs every 6 hours finishes on time, and the hosting network list it uses is refreshed weekly. | Bots get counted as people, so visitor numbers run high. |

## Guest checks

Send each request as a guest: method `GET` (`HEAD` also works), no cookies, no `Authorization` header, user agent
`dliu-status-bot/1.0 (+https://status.dliu.com/docs)`, and do not follow redirects. A check passes when the status code matches, the `Content-Type` starts
with the given type, and the expectation holds. Slower than "Slow after" counts as slow (degraded).

| Function | Method | URL | Status | Content type | Expect | Slow after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/ | 200 | `text/html` | body contains "dl-header" | 2000 ms |
| `pages` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/docs | 200 | `text/html` | body contains "dl-tabs" | 2000 ms |
| `pages` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/docs/health | 200 | `text/html` | body contains "dg-flow" | 2000 ms |
| `pages` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/docs/health.md | 200 | `text/markdown` | body contains "# traffic.dliu.com health checks" | 2000 ms |
| `public-stats` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/stats/7d.json | 200 | `application/json` | JSON with key "generated" | 2000 ms |
| `page-script` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/t/s.js | 200 | `application/javascript` | body contains "__dlTraffic" | 2000 ms |
| `signin` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/auth/login | 302 | — | Location starts with https://login.microsoftonline.com/ | 3000 ms |
| `signin` | GET | https://traffic.dliu.com/api/me | 401 | `application/json` | JSON with key "error" | 3000 ms |

## Health endpoint

- URL: `GET https://traffic.dliu.com/health` (`HEAD` also works). Outside `/api/`; no sign-in.
- CloudFront's `/health` behavior forwards no cookies, no `Authorization` header and no query string to the origin,
  and the handler (lambda/dashboard/health.js) reads none of them.
- Cached for 60 s at CloudFront (cache policy keyed on nothing; the response says `cache-control: public, max-age=60`),
  so the checks run at most about once a minute however often `/health` is requested.
- Read only: one cheap read per dependency, no writes, no S3 LIST, no Athena query and no AbuseIPDB call.
- Each check has its own 2 s timeout; the whole response returns within 5 s.
- `Content-Type: application/health+json`. HTTP `200` when `status` is `pass` or `warn`, `503` when it is `fail`.
  The top-level `status` is the worst of the functions'.
- `output` appears only when a function is not `pass`, and is a short generic reason: `timeout`, `read failed`,
  `stale`, `last run failed` or `no recent logs`. No names, counts or user data are returned.

Example:

```json
{
  "status": "pass",
  "time": "2026-11-03T23:00:00Z",
  "functions": [
    {
      "key": "public-stats",
      "name": "Public statistics",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "key": "signin",
      "name": "Microsoft sign-in",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "key": "logging",
      "name": "Request logging",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "key": "bot-check",
      "name": "Bot check",
      "status": "pass"
    }
  ]
}
```

| Key | Name | What it reads | pass | warn | fail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `public-stats` | Public statistics | When stats/7d.json was last written (S3 HeadObject) | Within 26 hours | 26–50 hours | Older than 50 hours, or the read fails |
| `signin` | Microsoft sign-in | The sign-in settings (SSM GetParameters, the same read sign-in does, cached 5 minutes) | The read succeeds | — | The read fails or times out |
| `logging` | Request logging | How often the log partitioner ran in the last 3 hours (CloudWatch GetMetricStatistics, one metric) | At least once | — | Not at all, or the read fails |
| `bot-check` | Bot check | The last run's status, bots/status.json (S3 GetObject, one small file), and when hosting/asns.json was last written (S3 HeadObject) | Finished within 7 hours, and the list is under 8 days old | 7–25 hours, or the last run failed, or the list is older | Older than 25 hours, or the read fails |

The `pages` and `page-script` functions have no `/health` entry; the guest checks above cover them.

## Not tested

- The signed-in dashboard: the Athena queries behind every widget are for the owner only.
- The Check bots now button and the AbuseIPDB reputation lookups (they need a sign-in, and AbuseIPDB's free allowance is limited).
- The page script's reports to /t/e: a test report would count as a real visit.
- Completing the sign-in at Microsoft (it needs an assigned account).
- The daily log merge and the monthly city database download are seen only indirectly: when they break, Public statistics or Bot check go stale.

## Rules

- The tests are read only and must never change content: `GET` or `HEAD` only.
- Never send `POST` to `/t/e` (it would be recorded as a visit) or to `/api/`.
- traffic.dliu.com drops requests whose user agent starts with `dliu-status-bot/` from its logs, so the tests never
  count as traffic.
